name: review-fixer
title: Review fixer
description: 4 times a day: on the maintainer's and the routines' open pull requests, fixes what trusted reviewers asked for, pushes commits to the PR branch and replies in every review thread.
notes: Its commits are authored by the bot app (set bot_app and bot_user_id in harness.json) while the committer stays the repository's git config, which signs them. It never resolves review threads: the pr-review routine counter-reviews its replies. It makes at most 3 rounds of changes for automated reviews per pull request.
